title: Amazon Product Scraper Input
description: Scrape Amazon products with rich enrichment. Paste search URLs, category URLs, direct ASINs, or seller store URLs. Each product ships as one dataset row.

startUrls.title: Amazon URLs
startUrls.description: Amazon search URLs (/s?k=), category URLs (/b?node= or /gp/bestsellers), product URLs (/dp/ASIN), or seller store URLs (/stores/ or /shops/). Mix and match. Each is treated as an entry point.

asins.title: Direct ASINs (alternative input)
asins.description: List of 10 character Amazon ASINs to scrape directly. Skip if you are using URLs. Combined with the marketplace below.

marketplace.title: Marketplace for direct ASINs
marketplace.description: Amazon marketplace used when ASINs are passed directly. Search and category URLs already carry their own marketplace.

maxResultsPerStartUrl.title: Max results per start URL
maxResultsPerStartUrl.description: Hard cap on products returned per search or category URL. 0 means everything Amazon exposes (typically up to 7 pages of 16 results).

extractVariants.title: Extract variant matrix
extractVariants.description: Pull all child ASINs, sizes, colors, and price points for products that ship in multiple variants. Built in. No extra cost.

extractBSR.title: Extract Best Sellers Rank
extractBSR.description: Pull BSR by category for every product. Includes primary and subcategory ranks. Useful for product researchers and FBA sourcing.

extractRatingHistogram.title: Extract rating histogram
extractRatingHistogram.description: Capture the percentage split across 5, 4, 3, 2, and 1 star reviews. Adds 200 to 400 ms per product.

extractFrequentlyBoughtTogether.title: Extract frequently bought together
extractFrequentlyBoughtTogether.description: Capture the FBT bundle ASINs and total bundle price.

extractAPlusContent.title: Extract A+ content
extractAPlusContent.description: Capture the brand A+ content blocks (rich product description with images and comparison tables).

deliveryZipcode.title: Delivery zipcode
deliveryZipcode.description: US zipcode used to set the delivery location cookie. Affects pricing and shipping estimates. Leave blank to use Amazon's default.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip ASINs already pushed in previous runs. Turn off to refresh stale rows.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of products processed in parallel. Three to four is safe. Higher concurrency triggers Amazon CAPTCHAs faster.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential is required for Amazon at any meaningful volume.
